name: ph-address-picker
description: Philippine cascading address picker (region/province/city/ZIP) for React, built on the @ph-dev-utils data packages.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@ph-dev-utils/address-core && npm run build --workspace=@ph-dev-utils/address-react && npm run build --workspace=@ph-dev-utils/address-element
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@ph-dev-utils/address-core && npm run test --workspace=@ph-dev-utils/address-react && npm run test --workspace=@ph-dev-utils/address-element
